# CostTrace

> CostTrace measures what each deployed code or infrastructure change actually cost, from an organization's real cloud bill, and attributes it to the pull request that caused it. It compares that with the pre-merge estimate. It is open source (Apache-2.0), multi-cloud (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud and Oracle Cloud via the FinOps FOCUS billing standard), and runs locally or in CI.

Key ideas:
- Measured, not estimated: reads FOCUS billing exports, using EffectiveCost (which includes the customer's discounts).
- Per change: deploys tag resources with costtrace_sha, costtrace_pr, costtrace_repo and costtrace_service. Each change is compared over N days before and after its deploy.
- Catches application-code cost: unmodified resources of the deployed service whose cost moved are reported as "affected".
- Every figure has a ± range from day-to-day variation. Shifts within noise are not listed.
- Not a budget or anomaly alert, and not a pre-merge estimator: it closes the loop between them.

## Docs
- [README](https://github.com/costtrace/costtrace#readme): overview, getting FOCUS data, limitations
- [How attribution works](https://github.com/costtrace/costtrace/tree/main/packages/core#readme)
- [Cloud connectors](https://github.com/costtrace/costtrace#getting-focus-data): s3:// (@costtrace/aws), azure:// (@costtrace/azure), bq:// (@costtrace/gcp)
- [MCP server for AI agents](https://github.com/costtrace/costtrace/tree/main/packages/mcp#readme): tools cost_of_change, cost_report, validate_billing_data, deploy_tags

## Packages
- [costtrace](https://www.npmjs.com/package/costtrace): CLI (report, validate, tags)
- [@costtrace/mcp](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@costtrace/mcp): MCP server
- [@costtrace/core](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@costtrace/core): attribution engine
- [@costtrace/focus](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@costtrace/focus): FOCUS reader (CSV, gzipped CSV, Parquet)
